fieldValues.title: Seven decision kinds, adopted to test
fieldValues.decision_question: Which kinds of decision does the log distinguish?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's walk of 2026-10-11 after session srs-programme#100; awaiting ratification.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Decisions are one of seven kinds: purpose, boundary, premise, preference, policy, design and mandate; a preference ratifies a method principle record rather than restating it, and a belief is recorded as a premise.
fieldValues.rationale: Each kind is a different promise about the future and needs a different frame and review. Cites the principle One way over carrying the old one: a preference lives once, as a principle record, and the decision ratifies it.
fieldValues.revisit_when: A kind is kept only if it is a difference that makes a difference; kinds that show no distinction in practice are merged.
